#### Recorded differences between the runs
- Tool commit (repro_radar_commit): 602a3224 in A, c10340ba in B. *(source: A pilot_record.json: repro_radar_commit; B pilot_record.json: repro_radar_commit)*

#### Outcome

- At least one of the runs has no extracted metric, so no metric value can be compared. *(source: A run_report.json: metrics; B run_report.json: metrics (not present))*

#### Time and memory
- The run phase took 1516.67 s in A and 14.995 s in B. *(source: A run_report.json: duration_seconds; B run_report.json: duration_seconds)*
- The peak memory was 1.11 GiB in A and 0.35 GiB in B. *(source: A run_report.json: meta.peak_memory_bytes; B run_report.json: meta.peak_memory_bytes)*
- The time of a run also depends on the load of the machine, which the run files do not hold. *(source: rule R2, docs/DIAGNOSIS.md section 8)*

#### Reading
- Rule R6: the outcomes differ, and the metrics cannot be compared. *(source: rule R6, docs/DIAGNOSIS.md section 8)*
